aether.pro_tips.line.aether.aerogel_expl: [Aether] Aerogel acts as an explosion-resistant, transparent block.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.aether_day_l: [Aether] Days in the Aether realm last 3 times longer than surface days.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.altar_repair: [Aether] Altars can repair damaged items and enhance existing items.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.ambrosium_sh: [Aether] Ambrosium Shards are great for fueling Altars.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.blue_aerclou: [Aether] Blue Aerclouds are bouncy, and launch mobs very high in the air.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.champs: [Aether] The Champs and Champettes are pretty baller.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.check_surrou: [Aether] Always check your surroundings before entering a fight.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.close_door: [Aether] Don't leave your house without closing the door.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.cold_parachu: [Aether] Cold Parachutes can be crafted with 4 Cold Aercloud blocks.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dart_shooter: [Aether] Dart Shooters can be crafted with Skyroot Planks and Golden Amber.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.darts_no_gra: [Aether] Golden, Poison, and Enchanted Darts are not affected by gravity.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.do_things: [Aether] The best time to do anything is before it's too late.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.drops: [Aether] If a drop looks too big, it probably is.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dungeon_rewa: [Aether] Dungeons can contain extremely powerful and unique rewards.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.dungeon_tier: [Aether] Dungeons have various difficulties: from Bronze, Silver, to Gold.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.enchant_blue: [Aether] Normal music discs can be enchanted into a blue version.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.enchanted_gr: [Aether] Enchanted Gravitite can be crafted into armor and tools.
[Aether] Enchanted Gravitite only floats up when powered.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.expectations: [Aether] Never expect that nothing will happen while you're gone.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.glowstone_po: [Aether] Place water into a Glowstone frame for a Hostile Paradise.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.golden_apple: [Aether] The leaves of Golden Oak trees occasionally drop Golden Apples.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.golden_oak_a: [Aether] Golden Oak Trees yield valuable Golden Amber in their logs.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.golden_parac: [Aether] Golden Parachutes have 20 uses rather than one.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.gravitite_ar: [Aether] Gravitite armor grants you higher jumps and no fall damage.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.gravitite_or: [Aether] Gravitite Ore can be enchanted into Enchanted Gravitite.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.gravitite_to: [Aether] Gravitite tools can levitate blocks when right-clicking.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.harvest_aech: [Aether] You can harvest Aechor Plant's poison with Skyroot Buckets.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.holystone_to: [Aether] Holystone tools occasionally generate Ambrosium Shards.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.icestone_fre: [Aether] Icestone freezes water into Ice and lava into Obsidian.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.mimic_chest: [Aether] Some dungeons in the Aether contain Chests which are Chest Mimics.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.mining: [Aether] You can always come back later and mine some more.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.moa_egg_incu: [Aether] Moa Eggs can be incubated into baby Moas with the Incubator.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.moa_nature_s: [Aether] Baby Moas will stay put when right clicking them with a Nature Staff.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.parachute_ac: [Aether] Parachutes auto-activate when falling off an island.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.phoenix_armo: [Aether] Try submerging yourself in water while wearing Phoenix armor.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.phyg_saddle: [Aether] Placing a Saddle on Flying Pigs makes them a mount.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.portal_miscl: [Aether] Be careful not to misclick when building portals.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.quicksoil_sl: [Aether] Quicksoil increases the speed of walking mobs and sliding items.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.raw_meat: [Aether] Raw meat is better than no meat.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.remedy_bucke: [Aether] A Skyroot Remedy Bucket for poison can be obtained by enchanting poison.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.risk_taking: [Aether] Don't take huge risks far from home.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.security: [Aether] Only give away your personal information to PayPal.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.sheepuff_puf: [Aether] Sheepuff occasionally puff their wool out, making them float.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.shelter: [Aether] A shelter made of dirt is still a shelter.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.skyroot_tool: [Aether] Skyroot tools gain double drops from blocks.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.spare_stack: [Aether] Always keep a spare stack of blocks in your active inventory.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.the_game: [Aether] The game is only as fun as you make it.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.victory_meda: [Aether] When Valkyries are defeated they will drop a Victory Medal.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.watch_your_s: [Aether] Watch where you step - deep shafts can be anywhere.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.white_aerclo: [Aether] Cold Aerclouds prevent fall damage when landed upon.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.zanite_tool_: [Aether] Zanite tools gain strength the more they are used.
aether.pro_tips.line.aether.zephyr_shoot: [Aether] Zephyrs shoot Snowballs with a force that can throw you off islands.
